data.content: {"story":{"as_a":"user managing my to-do list","i_want":"to update the details of an existing task","so_that":"the task reflects current information","business_description":"A user opens an existing task in the shared task form, changes its details and saves. The backend validates the change, and the user sees the outcome as a success or error message.","business_value":"Users can keep their tasks accurate without deleting and recreating them.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"An existing task is open in the edit form","when":"The user changes the title to a non-empty value of 100 characters or fewer and clicks save","then":"The backend stores the new title, the saved title is shown in the task list, and a success message is displayed"},{"given":"An existing task is open in the edit form","when":"The user clears the title field and clicks save","then":"The task is not saved, the form shows a message that the title is required, and the stored title is unchanged"},{"given":"An existing task is open in the edit form","when":"The user enters a title of 101 characters and clicks save","then":"The task is not saved, the form shows a message that the title cannot be longer than 100 characters, and the stored title is unchanged"},{"given":"An update request with a title of 101 characters","when":"The backend receives the request","then":"The backend rejects the request with an invalid input error and stores no changes"},{"given":"An existing task with a creation date of 1 March","when":"The user sets the due date to 28 February and clicks save","then":"The task is not saved, the form shows a message that the due date cannot be earlier than the creation date, and the stored due date is unchanged"},{"given":"An existing task is open in the edit form and the backend returns an error for the save request","when":"The user clicks save","then":"The stored task keeps its previous values, an error message is displayed, and no success message is displayed"},{"given":"A task that no longer exists is open in the edit form","when":"The user saves changes to it","then":"The backend responds with a task not found error, the form shows an error message, and no success message is displayed"},{"given":"A save request that sends a field value the backend does not accept","when":"The backend receives the request","then":"The backend rejects the request with an invalid input error, stores no changes, and returns the error to the frontend"},{"given":"An update request that omits the title","when":"The backend receives the request","then":"The backend rejects the request with a missing mandatory field error and stores no changes"},{"given":"A save request that fails because of an internal server or database error","when":"The backend returns the error","then":"The backend stores no partial changes and the frontend shows an error message"},{"given":"A task with stored values exists","when":"The user opens it for editing","then":"The edit form shows the stored values of that task"},{"given":"The request to load a task by ID fails, for example because the task does not exist or the server returns an error","when":"The user opens the task for editing","then":"An error message is shown, the edit form does not open, and no success message is displayed"},{"given":"A task list row for an existing task and a save of that task has failed","when":"The task list is shown after the failed save","then":"The task list shows the previous values of the task, not the values the user tried to save"},{"given":"A task list row for an existing task","when":"The user selects the edit action on that row","then":"The edit form opens with the stored values of that task"}],"edge_cases":["A title of exactly 100 characters is accepted; a
